A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same LongWriter-Zero research work, with 26 readable pages including Appendices A.1–A.10. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to the first-page affiliation marker and arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original RL training experiments, benchmark results, ablations, and human evaluations in Sections 2–3, with additional model-scale results and case studies in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original training experiments, benchmark results, ablations, human evaluations, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The GRPO procedure, length/writing/format rewards, Think prompting, and continual-pretraining pipeline in Section 2 are identical.

E1.justification: Training sources and task coverage are unchanged, including Chinese and English writing, WritingBench, Arena-Write, the human evaluation queries, and LongBench-Write in Appendix A.9.

E2.justification: The comparator sets match throughout Table 1, the SFT-versus-RL experiment, Figure 5's automatic and human comparisons, and appendix Tables 3–5. No baseline is added or removed.

E3.justification: Training configurations, preprocessing, evaluation sample sizes, metrics, judges, and response-order controls are unchanged in Sections 2–3 and Appendices A.2–A.5.

E4.justification: The thinking and continual-pretraining ablations, training-dynamics analyses, smaller-model experiment, and three case studies are retained unchanged, including Appendices A.7 and A.10.

E5.justification: Statistical and uncertainty reporting is identical, including the plotted bands. No run/seed information, confidence-interval reporting, or significance testing is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match. Examples include LongWriter-Zero's WritingBench score of 8.69 and Arena-Write Elo of 1447 in Table 1, Figure 5's win rates, and appendix Tables 3–5.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), covering the GRPO advantage/objective, length reward, preference loss, and reward aggregation, are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about RL-based ultra-long generation, performance relative to SFT, and the contributions of reward design, explicit reasoning, and continual pretraining.

C2.justification: Interpretations of planning, pretraining benefits, and thinking-length saturation are unchanged. Appendix A.6 retains the same reward-hacking limitations, including stereotyped openings, repetition, and keyword-driven reward inflation.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, filtering and evaluation prompts, pretraining-data proportions, and the reproducibility statement's planned code/model/data releases are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 4 and the bibliography are identical. No cited work or substantive positioning relative to prior research is added, removed, or revised.

P1.justification: Page 1 changes Yushi Bai's affiliation marker from 1 (Singapore University of Technology and Design) to 2 (Tsinghua University). The arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 28 February 2026 to v3 dated 8 April 2026. Other wording and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6, Tables 1–5, captions, prompt and case-study boxes, and their placement are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–26 are pixel-identical; the first-page text updates preserve its layout.

improvement.justification: The only differences update an author's affiliation marker and the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific content, empirical support, limitations, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation—including all appendices—remain identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality change.
